label: miso 230 ctdrag seam
definition: miso-230 full span: adds MISO's own derived CT net-load drag (clip(0.01303*netGW-0.8108, 0, 0.4394) over [10,21) CST, a zero-free-parameter window) on top of the miso-227 neighbour-anchored PJM seam ladder (byte-unchanged), replacing 2026-09-05-miso-220-nonsteam-lift as keeper. Fixes the one load-bearing cell that blocked promotion: CT_PEAKER 2023 -7.98 -> -4.32 TWh and 2024 -6.11 -> -3.31 TWh, both back inside the +/-8.00 TWh band, with reliability_floor's CT_PEAKER contribution dropping 2.6231 -> 0.0000 TWh so ct_netload_drag is now the sole CT forcing mechanism (D-2) in all three years. DETERMINATION CALIBRATED, C1 16/16 all-class and 12/12 free-class, C2/C3a/C3b/C4/C6 PASS, C3c the single ledgered caveat (rubric v3.3, non-downgrading); C8 passes only via rule 18's grounded above-budget route in every year (CT_PEAKER forced 49.2%/31.2%/34.0% of energy in 2023/2024/2025, above the 15% peaker cap but D-4 off-window-binding clears at 0.0000 TWh and each year's D-1 profile/CV-ratio gates pass).
